proposals.classification: Further source evidence for existing historical gauge-order candidate and related open record; proposed bounded current reconciliation, no new count and no automatic q608/q641 alias.
source_references: P16 separate earlier packet; pr-working recovered/95e crates/fabelgeist-armor/src/breastplate_design.rs:6–38,84–121
proposals.trace: BreastplateDesign has public deserializable wall_thickness Millimeters(u16). Current outer validate_breastplate checks profile, then an Anime relation, then fluting and catalog before rejecting wall gauge outside 1–20. Anime validation first bounds its own scalars, then computes gauge.0 * 2 for the lap-lift relation. The selected public design loader reads caller-provided bytes, invokes serde_json and then calls validate_breastplate; the selected code establishes a route but not actual acceptance of a malformed input by the native decoder or any runtime outcome.
proposals.condition: For otherwise-valid profile/Anime and a representable out-of-range gauge at or above 32768, multiplication exceeds u16; with overflow checks enabled it can fail before the outer gauge error. With wrapping semantics, default lap-lift 7 and 32768 produce zero and can continue to the outer wall check if other predicates pass. At MAX, the wrapped doubled value is 65534, so default lap-lift fails the inner Anime comparison and yields its error before the outer check.
proposals.historical_wording: Exact 774 NATIVE-CAMERA-SUPPORT03-P16-ARMOR-021 says MAX wraps and later rejects without specifying which predicate rejects it. Earlier /root/hair_ops noted the inner-site refinement; the historical text is ambiguous rather than necessarily contradictory. Preserve its exact bytes and attribution, not a rewritten claim.
safeguards: Profile and Anime scalar checks precede the relation; 1–20 wall range exists at the outer validator.
The selected loader validates after decoding; breastplate_design_hash separately validates before hashing.
None fluting and Solid/Anime are deliberate alternative states; keep valid values and cross-field relation explicit.
proposals.limits: No actual malformed decoder input, accepted retained mesh, panic, product run, build configuration or all-loader ingress is established. The 059 queue status does not become a newly accepted finding through a source trace.
proposals.future_direction: Determine the true supported raw-input boundary, error contract and canonical owner before any later implementation; preserve valid Anime/gauge semantics and meaningful structured rejection.

proposals.classification: Specific current support for existing pending fluting and distinct helmet topology investigations; q1814/q1815/q1818 are broad obligations, not proof of an accepted zero-segment defect. Do not merge first contracts or count new issues.
proposals.trace: PlateFluting and FluteCount are publicly constructible, derive Serde, and columns accepts a raw usize base_segments. For zero with an otherwise valid pattern the one regular-grid division is 0/0; unordered comparisons filter that NaN while boundary and flute samples are still added. An inspected BracerDesign columns route uses fixed base 32, and DeviceBracer::record validates before computing its layout; PlateChart separately passes its around field to either a regular grid or pattern columns.
safeguards: Fluting validation checks count 2–64, width/depth/spread/fade ranges and end>start before end-start and fade*2, so these unsigned operations are bounded on the path to them.

The selected bracer uses fixed 32 base segments and validates its design before computing columns. For a validated pattern, before dedup/pop at most 33 regular + 2 boundaries + 64×9 feature samples = 611.
The feature grid is deliberate: source comments explain avoiding thin strips from an unrelated interleaved grid.
proposals.limits: No supported caller passing zero, unvalidated pattern, resulting topology error, shader/device behavior, all chart constructors or overflow from unbounded around is established. q3141 concerns generic paired-ring/cardinality admission and selected helmet callers, a different source boundary; its central 95e assessment stays separate. We did not display prior-only unfan132–146 in this packet.
proposals.future_direction: Trace actual accepted chart/pattern producers and native consumers before deciding base-segment, output cardinality, endpoint and tolerance ownership; preserve ordinary pattern and unfluted modes.

bounded_lens_perspectives.producer_propagation: Selected JSON loader forwards raw breastplate design to validation; optional fluting is carried to a selected device with a fixed grid. Other callers remain open.
bounded_lens_perspectives.existing_type_owners: Millimeters and Permille own units, but a generic raw u16 does not establish a breastplate-gauge bound; catalog namespace ownership needs its real producer and consumer.
bounded_lens_perspectives.admission_contracts: Outer gauge admission occurs after the Anime cross-field operation; fluting checks protect its unsigned fade calculations on the validated path.
bounded_lens_perspectives.invariant_operations: Gauge doubling may exceed u16 before parent range rejection; columns divide by supplied base segments and retain a separate grid policy.
bounded_lens_perspectives.aggregate_states: Anime lift relative to thickness, profile ranges, optional fluting and a chart topology are cross-field relationships; validate each at the real owning boundary.
bounded_lens_perspectives.type_ownership: Distinguish raw authoring DTOs, checked design values and native device inputs without assuming one global owner or universal raw input is invalid.
bounded_lens_perspectives.redundant_authority: Original design and derived warmup alternate are separate states; no duplicate-authority finding is asserted without the remaining producer trace.
bounded_lens_perspectives.behavior_preservation: Preserve valid Solid/Anime choices, None fluting, valid scale factors above 1000 where permitted and existing purposeful feature-grid behavior.
bounded_lens_perspectives.enum_shapes: Solid and Anime have distinct payload modes; no enum reshaping is established by these windows.
bounded_lens_perspectives.derivability: Derived Deserialize makes raw authoring values representable; derivation itself does not perform the separate aggregate validation.
bounded_lens_perspectives.type_granularity: Raw unit, gauge admissibility, lap lift relation and catalog identity have different semantic jobs; no additional type is prescribed without caller evidence.
bounded_lens_perspectives.magic_strings: catalog_id is an authored identifier with nonblank checking; its namespace and consumers remain unproved.
bounded_lens_perspectives.magic_numbers: 32 base samples, count bound and local merge tolerance carry different purposes; check actual topology and error budgets before making a policy claim.
